item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently modifies the tariff schedule, designates listed countries, and grants qualifying imports duty-free treatment; the legal consequence occurs under the provision itself when the stated import conditions are met.","evidence":"The following beneficiary countries are designated as least-developed beneficiary developing countries"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently amends the governing GSP annex to add article 734.56, directly changing its eligibility for preferential treatment.","evidence":"is further amended by inserting in numerical sequence \"734.56\""},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently amends the GSP annex and tariff schedule and prescribes when those substantive eligibility changes take effect.","evidence":"The amendments made by this Order shall be effective with respect to articles"}]}
